authorizes: nothing; this config has no runtime, no venue access, and no REAL_MONEY implication
claim: A long-only Bybit book that holds the top 1-week-momentum decile of the top-100, admitted only while each name's own settled funding is <= 0 (the short side finances the move) and BTC's prior-30d return is above -0.05, earns squeeze-phase momentum net of settlement-exact funding and measured-turnover taker costs. The financing condition is the load-bearing part: unfiltered gated momentum longs earn bench Sharpe 1.57 and bleed -61 bp/day in 2022; requiring funding <= 0 lifts the bench window to Sharpe 2.87 raw / 3.17 vol-targeted (t 4.06) and makes 2022 flat (-3.9 bp/day). The improvement is monotone along the economic axis (funding cap none -> +1bp -> 0: bench Sharpe 1.57 -> 1.79 -> 2.87).

signal.note: top decile by 1-week return among names whose last settled funding is <= 0 bp/8h. The funding cap is the exchange-baseline boundary, not a fitted threshold: funding > 0 means longs are paying, i.e. the leader trade is crowded on the long side (those names were shown to keep rallying but with uncompensated crash risk - the D3a result).

gate.note: the house 2B regime conditioner at the Phase-5A t-chosen threshold (docs/archive/2026-07-24-anomaly-research.md section 18.6); prior-day window, PIT

cost_model.charging: measured one-way turnover x fee per side (mean 0.35 units/day, ~2.7 bp/day)
cost_model.provenance: 7.78 bp/side measured 2026-07-25 from 85 forward demo fills (all taker)

scoring_recipe.metric: mean net bp per day, and annualised Sharpe on raw and vol-targeted daily series
scoring_recipe.comparator: the deployed CONTINUOUS sl35 render (Sharpe 1.84, +15.85% over 2023-03-13..2026-07-16) and zero
scoring_recipe.grid: funding-cap curve {none, +1bp, 0} is part of the registered record; all cells reported in the evidence note
scoring_recipe.cadence: one row per completed UTC day after the registration commit
scoring_recipe.eligibility: only days strictly after the registration commit date count as forward evidence

benchmark_window_2023_03_13_to_2026_07_1.basis_note: PRIMARY basis is full-calendar: flat days count as zero, matching how the benchmark's Sharpe counts its own flat days. Corrected 2026-07-26 after registration; active-day figures retained below, labelled.

full_calendar.slippage_sensitivity: at fee_side 9.78 bp (+2 bp beyond measured): Sharpe 2.18
full_calendar.margin_note: the vol-targeted margin over the benchmark is thin (1.87 vs 1.84); the raw margin (2.21) is comfortable. The full-calendar vol target is penalised by leverage spiking after flat stretches; this is reported, not engineered away.

active_days_only.note: per-deployed-capital view; NOT comparable to the benchmark Sharpe

benchmark_window_2023_03_13_to_2026_07_1.verdict: beats the benchmark on Sharpe AND return on both raw and vol-targeted full-calendar bases (vol-targeted margin thin)

validation.binance_replication: same construction Binance-native (its own turnover ranks, funding, BTC gate): +28.09 bp/day, t 2.79, bench Sharpe 2.12 raw / 2.38 vt; effect ratio 0.65, inside [0.5, 2.0]. Registered separately as lane2_financed_leaders_binance_v1.
validation.entry_delay: +1h: bench Sharpe 2.65; +4h: 3.08 (a full 24h delay decays to 1.17 - the edge needs same-day execution of a fresh leader list, which the daily decision cadence provides)
validation.funding_cap_curve: bench Sharpe: no cap 1.57, <=+1bp 1.79, <=0 2.87 - monotone along the crowding axis
validation.multiple_testing: t 4.04 against the ~3.4 Bonferroni threshold for the program's ~63 mechanisms

measured_at_registration.provenance: Lane-1 exploration on 2021-01-01..2026-07-18 selected this configuration on 2026-07-26. These numbers CANNOT grade it. Full evidence note: docs/archive/2026-07-26-financed-longs.md.

known_weaknesses: correlated +0.75 with lane2_carry_hold_v1 and 41% of its name-days are also carry-hold names: both books harvest the funding-financed long-side premium in different phases (capitulation vs squeeze); they are two recipes, not two independent premia
thin: mean 3.0 names on active days, active ~47% of days; cash otherwise
2021 has only 18 active days (the gate and the financing condition rarely coincided in that bull); the config is effectively a 2022+ claim
the 24h-delay decay means the live implementation must trade the day-of leader list; a stale list halves the edge
long-only with market beta on active days; 2022 is flat, not positive
rides the post-2024 funding-inversion regime like carry-hold; a normalization shrinks deployment frequency
